主要内容: GlobalData's "Power Quarterly Deals Analysis: M&A and Investment Trends - Q1 2016" report provides detailed data on mergers and acquisitions, equity/debt offerings, private equity, venture financing, and partnerships in the power industry during Q1 2016. The report includes comparative data on deal numbers and values across the last five quarters, categorized by deal types, segments, and geographies. It also highlights top private equity, venture capital, and advisory firms in the power sector. The report covers key markets such as wind, fossil fuels, solar, hydro, and nuclear energy. It offers insights into deal trends, investment opportunities, and financial advisors involved in M&A and equity/debt offerings. The analysis helps investors understand market dynamics, identify growth segments, and evaluate capital-raising strategies in the power industry. The report is available at http://www.reportlinker.com/p01171292-summary/view-report.html.
